inlines.v: DRACO, noun [See Dragon.] 1. In astronomy, a constellation of the northern hemisphere, containing according to Flamstead, eighty stars. 2. A luminous exhalation from marshy grounds. 3. A genus of animals of two species. [See Dragon.]
